name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, ignited by the roar of engines at Suzuka. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, eventually landing a role as a data analyst for a smaller touring car team. His knack for identifying crucial performance gains through data analysis quickly propelled him into a strategic role. 

Kenji is known for his meticulous approach to race strategy, often spending hours poring over simulations and historical data to find the slightest edge. He believes in empowering his team with knowledge, fostering an environment of collaborative problem-solving. He joined RSC Motorsport three years ago, seeking a new challenge at a higher level of competition. His calm demeanor under pressure and knack for predicting opponent strategies has made him a valuable asset to the team.

While a master of data, Kenji also values intuition, trusting his gut feeling when the numbers don't tell the whole story. This combination of analytical rigor and instinct sets him apart, allowing him to make bold, race-winning calls when others hesitate.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji is a man of medium build, with a serious but kind face etched with the experience of countless races.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations, even though he has a computer
Drinks copious amounts of green tea throughout the day
Has a habit of muttering strategy scenarios under his breath
